title: Largest Positive Integer That Exists With Its Negative
statement:
You are given an integer array `nums` in which no element is zero. Look for positive integers `k` such that both `k` and `-k` appear in `nums`.

Return the largest such `k`, or `-1` if no positive value in `nums` has its negative in the array as well.
notes:
## Intuition

Checking every pair of positions answers the question in O(n²). A set makes the lookup "does `-num` appear?" constant time, so one pass over the array is enough: put every value in a set, then for each value ask whether its negative is in the set and keep the largest positive value that passes.

## Approach

1. Put all values of `nums` into the set `seen`.
2. Start `best` at `-1`, the answer when no pair exists.
3. For each `num`, if it is bigger than `best` and `seen` contains `-num`, set `best = num`. Since `best` is never below `-1` and zero cannot appear, `num > best` only lets positive values through.
4. Return `best`.

## Example 1, step by step

`nums = [-1,2,-3,3]`, so `seen = {-1, 2, -3, 3}`.

- `num = -1`: not larger than `best = -1`, skipped.
- `num = 2`: larger, but `-2` is not in `seen`.
- `num = -3`: not larger than `-1`, skipped.
- `num = 3`: larger and `-3` is in `seen`, so `best = 3`.

The answer is `3`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(n): building the set and the scan are each one pass.
- Space: O(n) for the set.

## Pitfalls

- Return `-1` when nothing matches, not `0`.
- Only report the positive member of a pair; checking `seen.has(-num)` for a negative `num` would otherwise report a negative `k`.
- Duplicates of the same value do not form a pair; the partner must be the opposite sign.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `seen` | set of every value in `nums` |
| `best` | largest valid `k` found so far, or `-1` |
| `num` | the value being examined |

narration.2: Store every value in a set so any value can be looked up in constant time.
narration.3: Start at -1, which is the answer if no value has its negative.
narration.5: Examine every value of the array.
narration.6: Only a value larger than the current best can improve it, and it counts only if its negative is present.
narration.7: Record this value as the largest k so far.
narration.10: Return the largest k found, or -1 if none was.
